Subject: Activation link returns 'nonce mismatch' (Helio / Okta)

Hi Jordan —

We received the supplier portal invite for Helio Systems and when our user tries to 'Activate account' the page shows an error: "Activation failed: nonce mismatch". We attempted the link in Chrome and Edge, cleared cache, and tried an incognito window. Same result.

Context: Helio uses Okta SSO and a corporate forward proxy that rewrites some outbound headers. The invite email includes the usual portal activation link (we've attached a screenshot).

Can you reissue the invite or advise a workaround? The PO needs to be approved by Friday.

Attachments: heliosys_nonce_error.png (screenshot)

Thanks,
Alex Kim
Head of Procurement Ops — Helio Systems
alex.kim@heliosys.com
+1 415-555-0199

Subject: Re: Activation link returns 'nonce mismatch' (Helio / Okta)

Alex —

Thanks for the report and the screenshot. Sorry for the trouble here. A few quick asks so we can triage faster:

- Can you forward the full URL you clicked (no need for the token values if you want to redact them, but the hostname/params help).
- If possible, grab the browser console network request for the activation POST (or the request id) — that helps correlate with our logs.
- Does your proxy perform URL rewriting or add a custom header (we've seen X-Forwarded-Proto or similar cause token canonicalization issues).

Workarounds we can try right away:
- I can manually generate a one-time activation and post it to you (valid for 24 hrs).
- We can send an invite that uses the alternate redirect endpoint which avoids the proxy rewrite path.

I've looped in Ben and Laura from onboarding/SRE to help confirm whether this is a token-binding edge-case on our side. We'll aim to have an action by EOD today.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

Jordan —

Thanks for the quick reply. Couple of follow-ups:

- Full clicked URL: https://portal.redwood-inference.com/activate?tid=helio-0923&nonce=REDACTED&d=po-228
- Our proxy adds X-Proxy-User and strips query params exceeding 2k characters in some legacy rules.
- Attached is the session log entry showing the activation POST and the 400 response (heliosys_session_log.txt).

A manual activation would be ideal if it can get us past the Friday PO cutoff. If you can also advise a longer-term fix so future invites for our org won't be blocked, that would be much appreciated.

—Alex
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@heliosys.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Activation link returns 'nonce mismatch' (Helio / Okta)

Alex / Jordan —

We've reproduced this in our staging environment when a proxy strips or normalizes query params and rewrites the Referer header. The short explanation: our activation flow validates a nonce token that is tied to the exact query string; when the proxy mutates the query or inserts/removes headers our validation sees a mismatch and returns a 400 with 'nonce mismatch'.

Immediate plan of action:
1) Jordan to issue a one-time manual activation token for the nominated PO contact (valid 24 hours) — will email the secure link separately.
2) Laura (onboarding) will create a short-runbook for Helio's IT that suggests either: a) allowlist the portal host through the proxy, or b) enable a passthrough rule for activation URLs so the querystring is not mutated.
3) SRE to add a telemetry tag so we can detect proxy-rewrite patterns and auto-fall back to our alternate redirect endpoint that is resilient to query param mutation (longer-term fix).

Ben Carter
Platform Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Note: Jordan will send the manual activation link via DocuSign secure URL in the next 30 minutes. If you prefer an alternate contact at Helio for the manual step, reply with name and email.
